days.dayNote:
**Arrival in Korea** — KE726 lands at ICN T2 20:05.
- Entry: K-ETA / e-Arrival Card sorted beforehand (todos). Immigration + bags ~45–75 min.
- In T2 arrivals: get a **WOWPASS** or **T-money** card at a CU/GS25 (top up with cash). T-money works on the subway, buses and most taxis.
- **AREX Express** to Seoul Station (~51 min from T2, ~₩11,000). Last express ~22:40 (verify). Fallback: AREX all-stop (~66 min, T-money) or a taxi (~60 min, ~₩70,000).
- Apps: **Naver Map** or **KakaoMap** (Google Maps directions are weak in Korea), **Kakao T** or **K.Ride** for taxis, **Papago** to translate.
- No Korean public holidays Oct 14–20 (Hangul Day is Oct 9; Chuseok is mid-September in 2027).

leg.label: AREX Express · ICN T2 → Seoul Station
leg.note: Express runs ~every 30–40 min; buy at the AREX counter/kiosk in T2 B1 or online. All-stop trains take T-money and are cheaper but ~66 min.

- **Hanbok:** wearing one gets you into Gyeongbokgung free; rental shops around the palace (~₩20,000–30,000 for 2 h).
- **Rain plan:** swap Bukchon for the National Palace Museum (on the palace grounds, free); Seongsu works indoors (Haus Nowhere, Olive Young, cafés).
- **Seongsu dinner ideas:** Seongsu Jokbal (pig's trotters, usually a queue — verify), Korean BBQ on the side streets, or ask your friend for current picks.
- Home from Cheongdam: taxi ~30 min (~₩20,000) or the subway until ~midnight.

K-beauty haul. **Tax refund with passport**: pay on 1F, then the instant refund at the 2F service lounge. Calmest before noon, busiest 14:00–20:00.

days.title: Busan · Sunrise temple & Haeundae coast
days.dayNote:
Monday. Sunrise ≈06:27 — Haedong Yonggungsa is at its best and nearly empty at dawn. Alarm ~05:15.
- Book a **Kakao T** taxi the night before, or ask the front desk to call one.
- **Sky Capsule:** a 2-person capsule is ₩40,000 one way (Jul 2026 price); book a timed slot online (bluelinepark.com, Klook, KKday) — slots sell out. The Beach Train (₩8,000) is the backup.
- Walk back from Cheongsapo on the flat Blueline coastal path (~2 km) via **Haewol Observatory** (free, 09:00–21:00).
- **Rest block:** the L7 rooftop pool (verify hours) or a nap — it's been a 05:45 start.
- **Dinner:** Haeundae Amso Galbi (no reservations; queue from ~17:00; can sell out). Backup: Haeundae Market or BBQ around Gunam-ro.
- **Rain plan:** skip the coast walk; move Spa Land (Tue) here and add Shinsegae Centum City (tax refund with passport).

items.title: Haedong Yonggungsa at sunrise
items.note: Opens ~04:30–05:00 until ~19:00; free. Sunrise ≈06:27 — stand on the sunrise rock to the right of the 108 steps. Crowded after ~10:00.

items.title: Breakfast · Geumsu Bokguk

On the coastal path back toward Mipo (~15–20 min walk); crescent deck 134 m out over the sea. Free, 09:00–21:00.

items.title: Lunch · Haeundae Market

Sunset ≈17:45, then Marine City's towers light up across the water. Drink on the terrace; Fingers & Chat for fish and chips.

items.title: Dinner · Haeundae Amso Galbi
items.note: Marinated beef galbi grilled at the table; finish with naengmyeon. No reservations — put your name down early.

days.title: Busan · Seokbulsa, Oryukdo & Gwangalli
days.dayNote:
Tuesday, the last full day. Make it an early night: wake-up ~06:00 tomorrow.
- **Seokbulsa:** taxis can drive the steep paved road almost to the temple. Ask the driver to wait (~30–40 min; pay the waiting fare), because calling a taxi up there is unreliable. Walking from Mandeok Station (Line 3) is ~2.4 km uphill (~1 h).
- **Oryukdo Skywalk:** 09:00–18:00 (last entry 17:50); free; closes in bad weather or strong wind.
- **Spa Land:** ~09:00–20:00, last entry 19:00, ~₩25,000 pp (verify the price and the Shinsegae closure days). Shinsegae Centum City has a tax-refund desk (passport).
- **Gwangalli:** Gwangan Bridge lights up after dark. The drone show runs on Saturdays only (as of 2025–26), so it's not on this trip.
- **Dinner ideas:** raw fish at Millak Raw Fish Center (민락회센터), grilled clams (jogae-gui), or a bridge-view pub on the beachfront.
- Jagalchi is closed on the 1st & 3rd Tuesdays (Oct 19 is the 3rd), which is why it's on Sunday.

leg.label: Taxi · Haeundae → Seokbulsa (driver waits)
leg.note: Say "석불사" (Seokbulsa). ~₩30,000 up + waiting time; estimate includes the wait.

items.note: Cliff-carved Buddha and guardian reliefs in a narrow rock gorge; views over Busan. Final stretch is steep. Free.

items.title: Lunch · Dongnae Halmae Pajeon
items.note: Dongnae pajeon: thick green-onion pancake with seafood, eaten with chogochujang. Hours/closed day unverified — backup: any gukbap or milmyeon place around Dongnae Station.
Glass U-walkway 35 m over the cliffs; the five Oryukdo islets. Start of the Igidae coastal trail if you want a 30-min extra walk.
Hot-spring baths + themed sauna rooms; a proper recovery before the flight day.

items.note: ~10 min from Centum (Line 2 → Gwangan). Sunset ≈17:44; the bridge lights up after dark. Coffee street along the beachfront.

The Korean friend is assumed for Sat Oct 16 (Hannam/Itaewon, dinner + bars); lunch/dinner on that day are left as the friend's pick.

Hotels are draft picks, not booked: Four Points by Sheraton Josun Seoul Station (Marriott; connected to Seoul Station for AREX + KTX) and L7 Haeundae by LOTTE (one block from Haeundae Beach). Room prices are estimates.

KTX 08:30 → 11:00 on Oct 17 is a placeholder slot, not a real train number. The fare is the 2025–26 standard fare. The 2-month booking window is confirmed from Oct 1 2026; the 07:00 opening time is not.
The Sky Capsule is modelled as a fixed leg (Mipo → Cheongsapo, 09:00 slot). The boarding item sits on the existing 'Haeundae Blueline Park' node, which is pinned at Mipo.

Low-confidence geocodes (pin before relying on them): Haus Nowhere Seoul, Zest, Geumsu Bokguk, Haeundae Amso Galbi, Dongnae Halmae Pajeon. Medium: Four Points, Olive Young N Seongsu, L7 Haeundae, Haeundae Market, Bonjeon Dwaeji Gukbap, The Bay 101, Cheongsapo.

Verified on the web (Sep 2026): Sky Capsule price and October hours, Haewol Observatory (opened Jul 2024, 09:00–21:00 Sep–Nov), Oryukdo hours, Starfield hours, Gyeongbokgung hours and Tuesday closure, Bukchon red-zone hours, Olive Young N Seongsu address and refund, Haus Nowhere (opened Sep 2025), Zest (Asia's 50 Best 2026 #2), Leeum 14-day reservations, KTX 2-month window, ZIM CARRY luggage delivery. These are marked 'verify'.
